(async () => { const app = window.__plume; app.state.tabs.push({name: 'redo.txt', kind: 'text', view: 'source', path: null, content: '', saved: '', dirty: false}); app.state.active = app.state.tabs.length - 1; await app.actions.render(); app.code.focus(); })()
if (window.__plume.commands.list().some(c => c.keys && c.keys.split('|').some(k => /^(Ctrl|Meta)\+Shift\+Z$/i.test(k)))) throw new Error('The app claims the redo shortcut')

(() => { const app = window.__plume; const keys = ['Ctrl+S', 'Ctrl+O', 'Ctrl+N', 'Ctrl+W', 'Ctrl+P', 'Ctrl+F', 'Ctrl+H', 'Ctrl+/', 'Ctrl+,', 'Ctrl+Shift+O', 'Ctrl+Shift+S', 'Ctrl+Shift+F', 'Ctrl+Shift+E', 'Ctrl+Shift+L', 'Ctrl+Shift+P', 'Ctrl+Shift+Tab']; for (const combo of keys) { const command = app.commands.list().find(c => c.keys && c.keys.split('|').includes(combo)); if (!command) throw new Error('Missing app shortcut: ' + combo); let hits = 0; const run = command.run; command.run = () => hits++; try { const parts = combo.split('+'); const event = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: parts[parts.length - 1], ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: parts.includes('Shift'), bubbles: true, cancelable: true}); app.code.view.contentDOM.dispatchEvent(event); if (hits !== 1 || !event.defaultPrevented) throw new Error('App shortcut was not handled: ' + combo); } finally { command.run = run; } } return keys.length + ' app shortcuts passed'; })()
